purpose: Replace V31 rigid donor transport by a train-only source-balanced Gaussian-copula Wiener decomposition: predict the conditional-rank phase component from target-free query fields, add the paired donor's residual innovation without translation, and test it against a zero-predictor innovation control.

inherited_inputs.selection_rule: reuse every frozen V28/V31 query, donor identity, and donor isometry byte-for-byte; donor translation and reselection are forbidden

gaussian_copula_coordinate.physical_residual: r=y_truth minus the frozen V14 corrected backbone including predicted residual DC
gaussian_copula_coordinate.conditional_rank: u=F_V31(r|backbone) from the exact frozen train-only 32-bin conditional CDF
gaussian_copula_coordinate.endpoint_regularization: u_mid=epsilon+(1-2*epsilon)*u with epsilon=1/(2*64^3)=1.9073486328125e-6; this is a fixed grid mid-rank map in probability space, not density clipping
gaussian_copula_coordinate.gaussian_score: z=Phi^-1(u_mid), followed by exact cube-mean subtraction before Fourier fitting
gaussian_copula_coordinate.inverse: u_generated=Phi(z_generated), then the unchanged V31 query conditional inverse and exact physical-residual mean projection

channels: asinh(native mean radial peculiar velocity / 100 km/s)
square of the frozen V14 corrected backbone
radius from observer divided by 10 Mpc/h
target_free_feature_fields.normalization: common train-only channel mean and standard deviation with exactly one-third total weight per TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift source
target_free_feature_fields.cube_dc: subtract every standardized feature cube mean before the Fourier transform

train_only_wiener_fit.data_and_cache: reuse and reverify all V35 kinematic3 train data and V21 train backbone caches
train_only_wiener_fit.source_balance: compute per-source averages of feature auto/cross covariance, feature-score cross covariance, and score power over all train cubes/modes; average the three source matrices with weight one third
train_only_wiener_fit.coefficient: for each band beta=(C_xx+lambda I)^-1 C_xz with real isotropic coefficients
train_only_wiener_fit.ridge: lambda=1e-3*trace(C_xx)/7 independently in each band, frozen before fit
train_only_wiener_fit.candidate_innovation_scale: sqrt(max(P_z-P_p,0)/P_e) per band from train covariances
train_only_wiener_fit.zero_predictor_scale: sqrt(P_z/P_e) per band so the control has the same train target band power without a query predictor

sampling.fourier_scaling_role: a frozen train-fit conditional covariance model component, never fitted to candidate or validation power and never changed after evaluation

development_evaluation.primary_pass: query_conditioned passes field plus Q3 and Q4 independently in every domain
development_evaluation.conditional_innovation_material: query_conditioned Q4/V31 <=0.75 and query_conditioned Q4/zero_predictor <=0.90 in every domain
development_evaluation.selection_role: only query_conditioned can be selected; zero_predictor is a frozen causal control

fixed_branches.condition: Q3 and Q4 pass every domain but any field check fails
conditional_innovation_material but Q3 or Q4 still fails

hard_preflight: full pytest and clean committed worktree
exact parent, V35 data/cache, V31 copula, selections, and V31 reference hashes
all normalization and covariance moments are source-balanced train-only quantities
all band covariance matrices, coefficients, powers, and scales are finite and positive where required
real-field Fourier prediction and innovation reconstruction round trip is below 1e-6 in Gaussian-score RMS
query_conditioned and control reuse identical donors and isometries with no translation
one real sample per arm is finite with residual DC below 1e-7
Astrid and historical EAGLE remain unopened
